title: NOAA OISST virtual stores
description: Byte-reference indexes of the NOAA 1/4 degree Daily Optimum Interpolation Sea Surface Temperature (OISST v2.1, AVHRR), read from the original netCDF files in the public NOAA bucket (noaa-cdr-sea-surface-temp-optimum-interpolation-pds). No data is copied. Each dataset is published as a GDAL multidimensional VRT, kerchunk Parquet, an Icechunk repository with virtual references, a flat Parquet refs store and a STAC collection. Drafts.
